note: Focused on the current composition and its parent_generation ancestry, capped at 15 generations (63 exist on disk in this checkout). Nodes are scoped per generation on purpose — the same cartridge id appearing in two generations is two distinct nodes, because the lineage between them is exactly what this graph exists to show.

nodes.label: composition 202609050354
nodes.reason: A WebGL canvas without preserveDrawingBuffer returns a fully transparent image when read outside a render frame, and it still encodes to a valid PNG that downloads happily. A blank file that looks like a successful save is worse than a refusal. And the print must fit the reader's paper rather than the one we assumed: size:auto with a flex column, not a forced A4 landscape with a fixed map height.

nodes.label: composition 202609050301
nodes.reason: View is where this application already keeps readings of the network over time - GB prices historic is moved into it by adoptLate - so a price and constraint time series belongs beside it. About would have filed it as provenance, which it is not: it is something to look at.

nodes.label: composition 202609050249
nodes.reason: Measured: the engine declares no dependencies and no proof in it opens a socket, so node verify.mjs runs all 133 checks from a clone, offline. The command shipped an hour earlier included npm install, which implied a network dependency that does not exist and would have made the offline claim false.

nodes.label: composition 202609050244
nodes.reason: Why are the mjs files not there - because the first cut filtered to canonical, and every .mjs in the estate is an extract, a reference or a fragment. All 44 nodes are listed now, fragments included, because a fragment is where a calculation has been copied and left to drift. The menu also hands over one command that runs: it is copied to the clipboard, never executed, so the person or agent that pastes it is the one who approves it.

nodes.label: composition 202609050238
nodes.reason: The attribution bar clashed with the menus - on a 393x852 phone, opening EDIT drew Status Colours underneath it - so it moves into About, small print at the bottom, credit intact. File becomes the way into the mathematics the application runs on. Both additions are guarded to settle to no-ops: adoptLate runs from a MutationObserver, and an unconditional append inside one is a feedback loop that crashed the renderer under the arrival gate.

nodes.label: composition 202609042123
nodes.reason: One stylesheet rule in the menu-bar module hid the whole v8 SCADA layers panel with display:none!important whenever the bar was hosted, and its justification was circular: the rule made the panel's height never change, which was cited as proof the panel's own toggle was inert, which justified the rule. Measured live on v9.115 at 1400x900 and at an iPhone 13 viewport: all 60 engine layer switches present in the DOM and zero of 120 reachable without opening a menu, with the page unable to scroll to them. The register, the voltages, the supermarkets, the transit and the EV layers were all there and none could be touched. The rule is replaced with display:flex, the toggle is un-hidden, and the panel starts open on a desktop as v8 always did and collapsed on a phone where an open panel was measured holding 31.6 percent of the screen against the map's 29.3. The dropdowns are untouched; the Grid dropdown proxies the same original inputs the panel shows, so the two cannot disagree. The architect's instruction verbatim: restore v8 panels but keep dropdowns file, edit, scope, grid, about. And: do not lose the grid engines - so the arrival's measurement is proven against these same composed bytes by the hidden-tab and five-case arrival browser proofs before this generation ships.

nodes.label: composition 202609041957
nodes.reason: Cutting two generations in succession, where the second restamped only the cartridge holding the version ledger, left each cartridge's proof binding its generation to its own filename and its version to the live composition - so the arrival cartridge's proof asserted the current version against a manifest one generation behind it. The identities are not wrong so much as split, and split identity is the drift this tooling exists to stop. One cut brings them back together.

nodes.label: composition 202609041956
nodes.reason: The ledger module lives among substation-intelligence's parts, so a generation that restamps only sld-sandbox leaves the newest ledger entry naming an earlier composition. That is exactly the drift the ledger exists to prevent, and the sld-sandbox proof catches it by comparing the newest entry against current.json rather than against any string inside the cartridge itself - two stale things agreeing is not a check.

nodes.label: composition 202609041954
nodes.reason: v9.112 charged the layer-control budget in visible time so a background tab could not spend the arrival before anyone saw it. That is right, and on its own it is unbounded: a tab never made visible would poll every 200ms indefinitely, which is a hang and a battery cost on the device least able to afford it. The loop now ends on whichever runs out first, the visible-time budget or a ten-minute wall-clock ceiling, matching the last-resort stop the arrival lane already uses. Both clocks are published: layer_controls_ready_ms is what the reader sat through and layer_controls_ready_visible_ms is what the budget was spent from, because reporting one of them alone makes a background arrival look instant or a foreground one look slow. Verified in Chromium and WebKit at 393px: the arrival is never attempted while hidden, the camera never flies while hidden, and once the tab is genuinely shown the camera arrives, the links draw and the card is on screen, with the resumed-on-visibility counter recording the recovery.

nodes.label: composition 202609041945
nodes.reason: The sld-sandbox part carried an iOS Safari fix that never reached the composed bytes: the layer-control budget was charged in wall clock while a background tab is not composited, iOS Safari does not tick requestAnimationFrame there, and map.flyTo() therefore never advances a frame and never throws - so the arrival ran to its own conclusion against a camera that had not moved, and nothing called it again once the tab was seen. It is now charged in visible time, deferred until the document is visible, and re-run on visibilitychange, bounded to five attempts so a real failure still stops. Measured live at 202609041500: duckdb-eh.wasm was fetched twice at 5.92 MB, 11.84 MB of a 12.81 MB arrival, because the bridge and the search lane each built their own runtime; they now share one through a window-keyed broker, so a phone holds one WebAssembly heap rather than two. And the GRID and SUBS chips, put on the map because the SCADA switches sit below a fold a phone never scrolls to, had been moved into the Grid dropdown by the menu bar; on a coarse pointer or a window at 700px and under they stay on the map.

nodes.label: composition 202609041330
nodes.reason: the v8 fullscreen letterhead stands down once the menu bar hosts the brand: #fs-letterhead paints only under body.fs-active, and the deep-link arrival's enterFullscreen() is its only caller -- every phone and no desktop -- so v9.110's fused masthead sat correctly at x=165 while a second 15px wordmark painted at x=254 over the SCOPE, GRID and ABOUT titles on every phone arrival, invisible to every desktop check

nodes.label: composition 202609041250
nodes.reason: The bar and the masthead were never two products fighting for the same screen; the bar was quietly eating the masthead by moving it into a panel nobody opens by default. Fusing the brand into the bar's own centre, restoring the SCADA panel's real branded head, and giving every layer control a full-size hit target closes that without adding a second row or a second control surface.

nodes.label: composition 202609041244
nodes.reason: isProjectTech() answers 'is this technology recognised', not 'is a control with this exact id on the page' -- link.technology_layer.enabled was wired to the first question and read by every prior proof as the second. wind_onshore and wind_offshore are Pipeline buckets, never layer ids; the engine's own combined wind layer covers both. other has no layer at all and is now said plainly instead of searched for.

nodes.label: composition 202609041221
nodes.reason: the credit's clearance depended on fs-active, which only a touch arrival's enterFullscreen() ever sets; desktop visits never set it and the credit sat under the bar. Now cleared unconditionally, offset measured from the bar's real rendered height and kept current by a ResizeObserver.
